Perfect — locking in Wed 5/26 at 3:00pm ET for a 30-minute demo. I’ve cc’d Lina for the pre-call.

Short answers to the questions you raised:
- OAuth scopes: we support granular scopes; for your workflow we commonly recommend repo:read, repo:status, and repo:write for PR comment automation. We can discuss the minimum set in the tech sync.
- Webhooks: we natively consume push, pull_request, and workflow_job; payload sizes are typical GitHub payloads — we stream processing and can handle large payloads; if you have very large artifacts we can discuss chunking or a pre-signed upload flow.
- On-prem connector: supported — we ship a lightweight agent that can be deployed behind your firewall. It communicates outbound to our control plane over TLS, and you can opt for customer-managed keys.

I’m attaching a short one-pager that outlines both hosted and on-prem flow (starlight_integration_overview.pdf).

If Lina is available for the 15-minute tech sync, what time works for you both? I can propose 2:30pm ET on Wed 5/26 (30 minutes before demo) as a tentative pre-sync.

Thanks,
